Overclocking.effect: +1 Response (raises Matrix Initiative) and +1 Initiative Pass in full-sim VR.

Resonance Link.effect: One-way empathic link to another meshed technomancer (mood, danger, pain); both can take it for a two-way link.

Biowire.effect: Skillwire at rating = submersion grade; active skillsofts emulated (see Emulation)

Blur.effect: +grade to the threshold of Matrix Perception to detect signature (incl. the 5+ threshold)

Coenesthesia.effect: Resonance+Intuition (3), subconscious detection; +2 to follow-up Matrix Perception

Defragmentation.effect: Resonance+Willpower (1 Combat Turn) Extended; each hit heals 1 box of living-persona damage; no other actions; not vs Black IC/Fading

E-sensing.effect: Resonance+Perception, Observe in Detail as Simple Action, range Resonance × grade m; more hits reveal more (1 hit presence/direction … 5+ Firewall/nanites/slaved/stealth tags)

Flexible Touch.effect: Forge signature: +grade threshold to identify the real one; signatures last 1 hour less per grade

Living ECM.effect: Jammer rating = grade; Complex Action to start, Free Action per pass to sustain; +1 per extra selection

Macro.effect: One extra non-combat Matrix task in a Complex Action at –2 per test; once

Immersion.effect: +1 die when jumped in; selectable twice

Multiprocessing.effect: Observe in Detail is a Free Action in VR/AR; extra Free Action per pass for non-combat tasks

Info Sortilege.effect: Data-search intuition (mild trance, –2 to other actions); Data Search + Resonance Test after ≥2 hits on Data Search + Browse; can "watch" a number of extra nodes = grade (half skill for tests there, half dice pool to defend). Needs Data Search skill and Browse CF

Sift.effect: Data Search threshold reduced by grade

Skinlink.effect: Skin as link (hack by touch even with jamming; target needs no skinlink); two skinlink technomancers can talk by touch

Sparky.effect: After damaging a hacker icon: Response+Willpower vs target Response+System; each net hit –1 Response of the originating node; 0 = node fails. Repair Hardware+Logic (8, 1 h) Extended. Ineffective vs technomancers, sprites, agents, AIs, e-ghosts

Swap.effect: –1 overall sustaining modifier for threaded CFs (max twice)

Acceleration.effect: +1 Reaction (augmentation bonus) and +1 Initiative Pass for real-world actions; up to 3×.

Advanced Overclocking.effect: counts as Overclocking taken twice: total +2 Response and +2 IP in full-sim VR; with hot-sim passes this reaches IP 5 (exception to the normal cap of 4).

Enhanced Resonance Link.effect: two-way telepathic link as Mind Link, exchange of data; one partner at a time even in a mesh.

Mesh Reality.effect: Free Action; perceive real world and VR together; use Matrix Initiative/passes in meatspace (not more passes than normal for real actions). Simultaneous physical and cybercombat: –4 to all pools (reducible for cybercombat only via Macro).

Mind Over Machine.effect: jump into any wireless device without rigger adaptation (hack in first if no access).

Resonance Exchange.effect: share one complex form or widget at a time with a linked technomancer (each option chosen separately; threaded CFs not shareable); rating limited by sharer's grade; sharer keeps use.

Resonance Trodes.effect: touch acts as trodes (share simsense/Matrix perception); unwilling target needs a touch attack, a subduing attack to hold, and Resonance+Willpower vs Intuition+Willpower.

Contaminate.effect: Resonance + Software + submersion grade (1 IP) Extended; each hit +1 to a temporary dissonance pool up to the dissonant's Resonance (a resonance well must first be reduced, with its rating as a penalty); node restores itself after grade hours unless the GM rules otherwise.

Malfunction.effect: reduce a sprite's tasks to 0 by decompiling (+grade), then Compiling (+grade) to take control; it recodes as an entropic sprite and may be registered.

Pryon.effect: code-induced diseases spread by touch. Black Shakes (Contact, Power 5, Body+Willpower (2) monthly; tremors –1 up to –4 on physical-attribute tests); Dysphoria (Contact, Power 6, Willpower (1) Test, mood episodes).

Siphon.effect: Cybercombat + Attack vs Response + System; 3+ net hits dumps the target (dumpshock); more hits but less than 3 = –2 dice for grade Initiative Passes. VR users only.
